name: 山鸣弓弦
special_effects_proposed: 弦鸣｜满弓箭命中敌人积攒1层弦鸣，最多3层，持续10秒；再次积攒刷新持续时间，每次射击最多获得1层。
山谷回响｜拥有3层弦鸣时，下一次满弓射击消耗全部层数，0.18秒后沿原发射方向补出一支弦影箭，造成原箭80%的物理伤害，不额外消耗箭矢或体力。
弦影｜继承原箭的暴击结果，不再次判定暴击；不叠加弦鸣，不复制贯穿、元素、照明或其他技能附效。穿心箭仅带入物理伤害。

mechanic_rules_proposed.echo_path: snapshot of the original projectile launch position, direction, speed, gravity and flight range; delayed independent projectile, no homing
mechanic_rules_proposed.echo_damage_basis: original outgoing physical component including its physical skill multipliers; target mitigation applies normally to the echo hit
mechanic_rules_proposed.echo_critical: inherit originating shot critical result; no second roll or repeated crit multiplier
mechanic_rules_proposed.stack_persistence: transient per equipped weapon instance; no saving stacks
mechanic_rules_proposed.draw_speed_policy: one shared draw-speed modifier for ordinary and Heart-Piercing draws; no separate skill-speed modifier

visual_design.cord: graphite-grey and silver-white tightly braided fibres, fine buried antique-gold filament
visual_design.ends: flexible woven loops with short silver-and-brass sleeves and subtle three-peak engraving
visual_design.center: matte charcoal finger-contact serving, narrow nocking locator; no protruding hardware under the fingers
visual_design.charge_readout: three gold-thread chevrons above the serving illuminate one by one; full charge produces a thin warm-gold filament
visual_design.release: brief paired afterglow, no large screen-covering flash
visual_design.interfaces: preserve original upper/lower limb string anchors, brace nock and draw-hand contact; production fit deferred until model authorization

design_rationale: Reward deliberate full-draw accuracy with periodic physical burst; the independent string slot complements Far Peak and Cloudpiercer body choices. Holding duration is not used as a benefit.
